title: Care Program Co-Funding of Retail OTC Receipts
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — co-funding with Care Management programs.** Part of a posted retail register receipt is co-funded by the member's care program: the receipt allowance charge is multiplied by one minus the care program co-funding share, within the product and before the charge is limited to the allowance balance and rounded.

**Rule.** The care program co-funding share is twenty percent (0.2) for a member with an active Maternal Care Management care episode, ten percent (0.1) for a member with an active Healthy Living Support care episode, and nothing otherwise.

The episode read is the member's Care Management episode in active status and its tier.

### Share table

| Active Care Management episode | Co-funding share | Charge multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Maternal Care Management | 20 percent | 0.8 |
| Healthy Living Support | 10 percent | 0.9 |
| Any other tier, or none active | Nothing | 1 |

### Points of judgement

*An episode of Maternal Care Management is on record but closed.* No co-funding: only an active episode counts.

*The member's active episode is Complex Case Management.* No co-funding: only the two tiers above carry a share.
